title: The quality control behind every batch of Agri-Shell
summary: Before packaging, every batch of Agri-Shell biofertilizer — liquid or granular — goes through lab testing and strict hygiene protocols.
body:
The quality of a biofertilizer is decided as much in the lab as in the field. At Bio-Gaz-Benin-Afrique, digestate samples are collected, labeled, and analyzed before being processed into liquid or granular Agri-Shell.

Bottling and packaging follow hygiene protocols — hairnets and appropriate equipment — to guarantee a reliable product for the farmers who trust us.
